name: topencode
description: TUI + tmux session manager for coding agents (opencode and Claude Code), attachable over ssh

scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:tclaude
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/topencode ~/.local/bin/.topencode.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/.topencode.new ~/.local/bin/topencode && echo 'installed to ~/.local/bin/topencode'
scripts.install:local:tclaude: bun run build:tclaude && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && cp dist/tclaude ~/.local/bin/.tclaude.new && mv -f ~/.local/bin/.tclaude.new ~/.local/bin/tclaude && echo 'installed to ~/.local/bin/tclaude'
scripts.install:all: bun run install:local && bun run install:local:tclaude
